hermeticity.method: I first reconstructed focus-only models from فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا and the two focus branch inventories, then evaluated context_root_cues in packet order as possible activators. I retained coexisting physical, strategic, social, material, and epistemic mechanisms whenever each returned to وَسَطْ, جَمْعًا, or the بِهِۦ construction.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a one-call reconstructed trace: the focus ayah and all context were visible together, so the baseline/context sequence is analytical rather than a strict blind reveal history. Branch images are packet evidence, while every causal direction, analogy, and cross-domain transfer identified as an inference is reader-supplied. No external source was consulted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَسَطْ as a finite plural verb plus جَمْعًا as its gathered field
baseline_models.mechanism: The verbal middle-branch supplies ingress rather than static centrality, while the group-branch supplies an assembled body. Together they form a topological event: plural movers pass from an edge into the interior zone of a collective.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Entering, or causing placement, in the middle.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the focus event's inward topological motion.

activation_trace.branch_image_ar: جماعة اجتمعت أو أخلاط ضمتها الجهة
activation_trace.literal_contribution: An assembled body, mixed multitude, or army.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the bounded collective whose middle can be entered.

changed_reading.before: A minimal gloss in which the movers merely arrive among some people.
changed_reading.after: The movers penetrate from the collective's edge into its interior center; جَمْعًا is a spatially organized body, not just nearby people.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of وَسَطْ with the force-gathering branch of جَمْعًا
baseline_models.mechanism: A middle between sides supplies a point of maximum inward reach, and gathering motion supplies concentration. The packet gives the two images; I infer that reaching the center marks the culmination of converging momentum.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: A center defined between surrounding sides or ordered parts.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the point toward which movement converges.

activation_trace.branch_image_ar: استجماع القوة أو السير حتى تتلاحق أجزاؤه
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Force or motion gathers until its parts catch up and become concentrated.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Turns the entry into a culmination of accumulated momentum.

changed_reading.before: A location change: they moved into a middle.
changed_reading.after: The middle is the convergence point at which previously distributed motion becomes a single concentrated force.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَسَطْ as ingress and جَمْعًا as the making of a whole from dispersion
baseline_models.mechanism: The collective need not be a passive, already fixed target. The جمع branch exposes an active relation between scattered parts and a collected whole; entry into its middle can therefore be read as contact with the organizing point of that whole. The claim that ingress may reconfigure it is my inferred arrow.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Entering or setting something in the middle.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Places the movers at the organizing interior of the field.

activation_trace.branch_image_ar: ضم المتفرق حتى يصير شيئا مجموعا
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Scattered parts are joined until they become one collected whole.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the target a produced configuration whose integrity can change.

changed_reading.before: The gathering is a fixed crowd that merely receives the entry.
changed_reading.after: The entry reaches the organizing middle of a collected whole and may alter how its previously distributed parts hold together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mediation branch of وَسَطْ and the concerted-resolve branch of جَمْعًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Two social branches coexist with the physical reading: وسط can act between parties, and جمع can collect divided opinions into one resolve. Their conjunction permits an interposition into the decision-center of an alliance. This is form-distant from the most direct verbal construal, so it remains exploratory rather than replacing physical ingress.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Mediation or action between human parties.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Recasts middle-entry as interposition among parties.

activation_trace.branch_image_ar: عزم محكم جمع الرأي بعد تفرقه
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Scattered opinion is gathered into firm, concerted resolve.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies a strategic or deliberative collective center.

changed_reading.before: The middle is exclusively physical and the gathering exclusively bodily.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting social reading appears: the movers interpose within a coalition at the point where its divided intentions have become concerted resolve.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cutting branch of وَسَطْ against the intact-whole branch of جَمْعًا
baseline_models.mechanism: One accepted وسط branch makes the middle the line at which a thing is divided into halves, while جمع can mark intact totality. Their tension permits the center to be a faultline: reaching it threatens the integrity that جَمْعًا names. The cutting sense is associated with a derived form in the branch scope, which limits confidence but does not erase the activation.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Cutting a thing into two halves at its middle.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the center a latent division-line rather than only a destination.

activation_trace.branch_image_ar: اكتمال الشيء كله بلا تفرق أو نقص
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Wholeness without scattering, loss, or deficiency.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the integrity put at risk by contact with the middle.

changed_reading.before: The center is simply the safest description of where entry ends.
changed_reading.after: The center is also the gathered whole's faultline: penetration there carries the possibility of bisection and loss of integrity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Running supplies rapid approach, panting supplies embodied exertion, and the co-present transgression branch makes a limit available. I infer that the focus movement does not merely occupy a center: it overruns a boundary and reaches the defended interior of the assembled body.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Ingress into the middle.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Anchors the result of the approach in the focus verb.

activation_trace.branch_image_ar: جماعة اجتمعت أو أخلاط ضمتها الجهة
activation_trace.literal_contribution: An assembled multitude or army.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Provides the organized body whose perimeter and center differ.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Running at speed.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies rapid directed approach toward the center.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Passing beyond a limit, with a possible transgressive valence.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Changes neutral ingress into threshold-overrun.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: The audible sound of panting.
activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the breach bodily, effortful, and acoustically present.

structural_cues: The plural feminine action at 100:5 continues the action-chain opened by the plural feminine participant in 100:1.
Successive fā-links make the center-entry a consequence rather than an isolated pose.

abductive_moves.assumption: A rapidly reached center implies crossing the collective's outer limit.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Running, passing beyond a limit, entry into a middle, and an assembled body.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: Speed is directed across a perimeter and culminates as a breach of the collective's interior.
alternatives: The runners could enter an open, undefended crowd.
The limit branch may remain morally colored without describing spatial defense.

changed_reading.before: They penetrate the center of an assembled body.

discarded_or_unchanged: Focus و س ط B001 (justice/choice) and B004 (middling rank) created a value contrast but no context cue changed the finite plural event through that contrast; they remain unused rather than being promoted as adjectival translations.

Focus ج م ع B006 (sexual joining), B012 (large pot), and B013 (joining another in support) did not produce a distinct mechanism beyond the retained containment, strategic, and vessel-like models; bare lexical resonance was insufficient.
ض ب ح branches for burnt wood, blackening, and ash echoed the fire/dust material chain but did not change the focus beyond the stronger ignition and self-generated-cover models.
The beverage, sleep, camel, poison, insult, honey, bird, animal, and proper-name branches across ص ب ح, ن ق ع, ش ه د, ع ل م, ق ب ر, and ر ب ب produced no focus-anchored directional mechanism.
ش د د B003 (charging/running) strongly confirmed the kinetic baseline but merely repeated the already changed boundary-overrun reading; it was not promoted as a duplicate delta.

خ ي ر branches for gift and drawing an animal from its hole, and ق د ح branches for cup, tooth wear, and scooping from a pot, remained local images without a non-duplicative change to وَسَطْ or جَمْعًا.

strongest_changes: Neutral center-entry became an exertive boundary-overrun when running and transgression activated the distinction between perimeter and interior.
Latent fire and striking changed already-given motion into generated, released, and concentrated force; alternate branches changed the same clause into execution of a concealed plan.
Stirred dust plus adjacent repeated بِهِۦ activated a self-generated medium of ingress that can both conceal the movers and leave a witnessing trace.
The turn to heart-attachment, beneficial good, and binding intensity made the outer collective center coexist with an inner accumulative center occupied by desire.
Later uncovering, scattering, collection-until-result, kernel extraction, and knowledge of interiors reversed the focus topology and recast center-entry as an assay-like operation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained productively polyphonic: tactical penetration, concentrated discharge, strategic execution, environmental self-concealment, relational fracture, affective accumulation, reversible gather/scatter, and inner extraction all remained live. Accepted non-dominant mappings were especially productive: ء ث ر made dust a sign, ع و د made ingress recurrent, and ر ب و supported a contained ecological outlier. Specialized focus branches also exposed faultline, hydrological, projectile-container, botanical, and gestational structures without promoting them to direct translations.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent and precise instrumental role of بِهِۦ remain unresolved; dust-enabled ingress is an abductive option, not a grammatical settlement.
جَمْعًا can support a target host, a collected state, concentrated motion, or specialized lexical images; the packet does not force these into one syntactic reading.
The direction from sparks, dust, desire, or later extraction back into the focus is reader-inferred even where the branch sequence is tight.
Split-root and specialized-branch outliers are legitimate activations but carry substantial form and domain distance; they should remain explicitly contained.
The physical, strategic, ethical, and epistemic models compete in places, but no packet evidence requires selecting one and deleting the others.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Penetrating the assembled center.** Evidence: و س ط B003 entering the middle; ج م ع B002 assembled group/army; ع د و B009 edge/bank; غ ي ر B003 altering state. Structural cue: packet motion progresses edge-run → ignition → morning incursion → dust → center-entry. Role: وسط is the tactical culmination; جمع is the target body. Abductive move: the prior flank/edge movement is completed by entry into the group's core. Reading change: the ayah reads as the moment the outside force becomes internal to the collective.

2. **Judicial center invaded by appetite.** Evidence: و س ط B001 just/choice balance; ج م ع B003 concerted resolve; later ك ن د B002 ingratitude, ح ب ب B002 love, ش د د B002 intensity. Structural cue: after the oaths, the moral subject is judged. Role: وسط supplies a norm of balanced middle; جمع supplies unified intention. Abductive move: the raid image activates a later moral model where intense desire penetrates and displaces the balanced center of judgment. Reading change: 100:5 becomes a psychological figure: the human's inward assembly is occupied by severe love of "good."

3. **Gathering as future court.** Evidence: ج م ع B004 gathering-place/day/summons; ش ه د B001 presence with witnessing and B002 testimony; ع ل م B001 knowledge; خ ب ر B001 tested knowledge. Structural cue: the word جمع appears before later knowing, witnessing, and divine expertise. Role: جمع becomes not only an army but a convened body. Abductive move: a gathered host can foreshadow a gathered forum where hidden contents are made evidentiary. Reading change: the ayah reads simultaneously as battle-center and proto-tribunal.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 100:10-11 made "جمع" less exclusively martial: gathered army, gathered forum, and gathered account converged. 100:8 added the inward version, where severe love enters the middle of judgment, so the center-entry becomes psychological as well as spatial.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Peripheral force reaches an organized center.** `و س ط B003` supplies entering or being placed in the middle, and `ج م ع B002` supplies an assembled group or army. The prior sequence moves from running to ignition, raid, and obscuring dust; this ayah converts approach into interior position. The group is the structured target and the middle is the achieved location. The packet gives the path and endpoint; I infer that the earlier phases enable the breach. The line reads as completed penetration of an organized body, not simply proximity to a crowd.

2. **The runners gather their own force while entering the gathered target.** `ج م ع B010` includes a horse or flood gathering speed until motion is concentrated, while `B001` and `B002` supply collection and the collected body. This creates a structural double use: a converging force meets a preassembled force. The packet supplies a horse-speed image in the branch and a `جَمْع` as endpoint; I infer that the kinetic sequence concentrates the agents before impact. The object can remain the gathered group while also activating a mirror-image of gathered momentum on the agents' side.

3. **Gathering is temporary and subject to analytic reversal.** `ج م ع B001` gathers scattered parts and `B009` marks wholeness without loss. Later, 100:9 activates `ب ع ث ر B002`, scattering and overturning contents, and 100:10 activates `ح ص ل B001`, recollecting a thing until its outcome is clear. The three operations form collect, disperse, and resolve. The packet supplies the operations; I infer that the latter two audit the first rather than merely follow it. `جَمْعًا` therefore reads as an aggregation whose apparent unity will be broken open and recomposed as a disclosed result.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 100:9-10 expose the gathered body's instability. `ب ع ث ر B002` disperses what had appeared whole, then `ح ص ل B001` recollects it as a resolved outcome. The surprise is that 100:5's culmination is also the starting material for a later audit: reaching the center does not settle the matter; it makes the aggregate available for disassembly and assessment.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, iki uç arasında veya sıralı parçalar içinde bulunan yeri açıkça temel anlam yapar. Başın ve topluluğun ortası, kolyenin merkez taşı, orta parmak, sıralamadaki orta ibadet ve iki yer arasındaki konumuna göre adlandırılan şehir bu konumsal çekirdeğin farklı uygulamalarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin iki uç veya parçalar arasındaki yer anlamı tanımın çekirdeğidir; takı, parmak, ibadet sırası ve şehir adıyla ilgili kullanımlar kendi yapılarıyla sınırlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin iki ucu arasında veya sıralı parçaları içinde bulunan orta yer; belirli nesne, beden bölümü, sıra ve yer adlandırmalarında bu konuma bağlı özel karşılıklar kazanır.

facets.statement: Orta, iki uç arasında ya da bir bütünün sıralı parçaları içinde bulunan konumdur.
Takının merkez taşı, orta parmak ve sıralamada orta sayılan ibadet bu konumun yapıya bağlı özel uygulamalarıdır.
Bir şehir adı, iki başka yer arasındaki konumuna dayanan bir adlandırma olarak açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iki uç veya bir bütünün parçaları arasındaki konumu ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve bu çekirdeği beden, takı, ibadet sırası ve yer adlandırması gibi özel alanlarda örneklendirir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: النصف، ضربت وسط رأسه، وسط القوم (maqayis)؛ الوسط مخففا يكون موضعا للشيء، اسما لما بين طرفي كل شيء، واسطة القلادة جوهرة تكون في وسط الكرس المنظوم (ayn)؛ الأصبع الوسطى، واسطة القلادة، واسط بلد سمي بالقصر بين الكوفة والبصرة (sihah)؛ ما كان يبين جزء من جزء فهو وسط، وسط الدار، واسطة القلادة (tahdhib)؛ وسط الشيء ما له طرفان، الصلاة الوسطى بين الركعتين وبين الأربع أو بين صلاة الليل والنهار (mufradat)

lexicalization_scope.note: Topluluğun ortasına girme, belirtilen yapıya bağlı bir kullanımdır; bir şeyi ortaya yerleştiren biçim ayrı eylem yüzü olarak korunur ve ikisi durağan yer anlamıyla karıştırılmaz.

morphemes_tsv.note: ayah attribution taken from qac_ref, with non-surah rows and standalone basmala ayah marker rows (1:0) filtered out | dropped_preface_rows=7

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

source_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

tier_contracts.explicit_interest: Full source branch payload, except fields removed from all tiers.
tier_contracts.local_low_branch_safety: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status, branch_kind, and reviewed/dictionary concept/context gloss text.
tier_contracts.compact_rest: branch_ref, payload_tier, branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, status; a semantic fallback is added only when both Arabic fields are empty.

branch_policy.compact_gloss_policy: Reviewed gloss branches remain as branch_ref/payload_tier stubs; their branch records are trimmed, not filtered out.
branch_policy.note: Every root target and dictionary branch identity is retained. Branch payload detail is tiered from generation-time citations; non-full branches and reviewed gloss records are trimmed, not absent. Root lexicon and branch inventory availability never create interest.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
